summary.what_it_does: This page is a comparison article of ten AI email assistants, tested by the author over two weeks. Each entry covers standout features, pros and cons, and pricing for tools such as Shortwave (AI email search and calendar scheduling), Microsoft Copilot Pro for Outlook (drafting, thread summaries, and Coaching by Copilot tone feedback), and Gemini for Gmail (inbox summaries and reply drafts). It also explains what AI can do for email in general, including sentiment and intent analysis, auto-tagging, summarization, data extraction, and translation. The author lists evaluation criteria: easy integration, inbox management, AI features beyond text generation, productivity and automation, and data privacy. Zapier is promoted as a way to connect AI assistants to email apps.
notable: Ranks ten AI email apps with a pricing table and per-app pros and cons
Shortwave schedules meetings from natural-language prompts
Apple Mail AI can run locally on supported Apple devices
Copilot Coaching gives tone and structure feedback on drafts
caveats: Shortwave works only with Gmail accounts for now; an Outlook waitlist exists
Microsoft Copilot only works with Microsoft-domain email addresses such as outlook.com, live.com, or hotmail.com
Apple Intelligence requires a compatible Apple device; the author's iPhone was too old
Most AI email features require paid plans, and Superhuman starts at $25/user/month
